description.narrative: The project’s objective was to support the transformation to market-driven widescale deployment of on-grid solar PV in industrial SMEs through the installation of 125 MW of on-grid solar PV capacity by industrial SMEs. A total of 700 SMEs and 2 banks were to be supported by the technical assistance, out of which around 350 SMEs were expected to benefit from the financial support mechanism. The project intended to demonstrate that public and private finance could be leveraged, innovative financial solutions were viable, and enabling frameworks were in place for enhancing GHG emission reduction (the project aimed to mitigate approximately 192,000 tonnes of CO2e over the five-year duration), the implementation of the national renewable energy strategy and the NDC, market development, including increased competitiveness, low-emission/modernised production, green job creation, and energy security through replicable and scalable PV deployment in the industrial sector.
